Message:
sched: Wrap the 'cfs_rq->nr_spread_over' field with CONFIG_SCHED_DEBUG

cfs_rq->nr_spread_over is only used when CONFIG_SCHED_DEBUG is set.
So wrap it with CONFIG_SCHED_DEBUG.
